text: Customer invoices are retained for seven years.
A service owner and a security reviewer must approve every production access request.
Encrypted production backups are retained for thirty days.
Critical security incidents must be acknowledged within fifteen minutes.
Multi-factor authentication is required for every administrator account.
A verified customer deletion request must be completed within thirty days.
The production service availability target is 99.9 percent per calendar month.
Priority-one support incidents receive an initial response within one hour.
